spans.s:
(ए) ह्रगे r. 1st cl. (ह्रगति)
To cover.

f. (-या)
1 Censure, reproach.
2 Shame.
E.
हृणीङ् Kaṇḍvādi root, to feel shame, यक् aff., form irr.: see ह्रिणीया.

m. (-दः)
1 A deep lake, a large or deep piece of water.
2 A ray of light.
E.
ह्राद to sound, aff. अच्, and the deriv. irr.

r. 1st cl. (-ह्रादते)
To sound, inarticulately.

m. (-दः)
Noise, sound.
E.
ह्राद to sound, aff. अच्.

m. (-हः)
An alligator, a crocodile.
E.
ह्रद a lake, and ग्रह abode.

f. (-नी)
1 A river in general.
2 Lightning.
E.
ह्रद deep water, इनि and ङीप् affs.

r. 10th cl. (ह्रापयति)
To speak.

r. 1st cl. (ह्रसति)
1 To sound.
2 To be small or few.

m. (-सः)
Sound, noise.
E.
ह्रस to sound, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made little, diminished.
2 Sounded.
E.
ह्रस to sound, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very short or small.
E.
ह्रस्व short, aff. of the irr. superlative इष्ठन्, form irr.; also with इयसुन् aff. ह्रसीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः).

m. (-मा)
Smallness, shortness.
E.
ह्रस्व short, small, इमनिच् aff., form irr.

mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं)
1 Short, low in stature.
2 Short, as a vowel.
m. (-स्वः)
A dwarf.
E.
ह्रस to be small, and व aff.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
E.
ह्रस्व short, गवेधुका coix.

m. (-र्भः)
A short kind of Kuśa grass.
E.
ह्रस्व short, दर्भ the same.

m. (-कः)
A sort of Bassia.
E.
ह्रस्व short, पत्र a leaf, and कन् added.

m. (-ग्निः)
The gigantic Asclepias, (A. gigantea.)

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A medicinal root, commonly

Jīvaka.
2

A dwarf.
E.
ह्रस्व short, and अङ्ग the body.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Sounding, making a sound or noise.
f. (-नी)
1

Lightning.
2

INDRA'S thunderbolt.
3 A river in general.
4 The Olibanum tree.
E.
ह्राद to sound, affs. इनि and ङीप्.
